label: Under strain
summary: Sunday's weight sits in the Gulf. Houthi strikes on Riyadh's main airport killed at least 12 on Saturday and hit again Sunday, drawing global condemnation, while Washington said it may join Saudi Arabia's fight. Talks to end the Iran war look stalled and Hormuz attacks are intensifying. In Ukraine, a Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed 20 even as US-hosted talks in Miami were called productive. A migrant boat capsized off Djibouti, leaving at least 139 dead, and Pakistan suspended the government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Nature tested the Americas: Hurricane Isaias cut power to 664,000 on the Gulf Coast and a 7.7 quake shook central Panama, with no deaths reported from either. Markets held up, logging a weekly gain after fresh records. Science offered lift, from a self-regulating nuclear clock to Australia's three new national parks. The weighted formula gave 40; no editorial adjustment.
